preconditions.description: The number of rooms in the hole is between 2 and 105, inclusive.
The room identifiers are between 1 and n, inclusive.
The time to pass through a tunnel is between 1 and 106, inclusive.
The number of different values of l is between 1 and 50, inclusive.
The value of l is between 1 and 1011, inclusive.

postconditions.expression: The output is a list of integers, each representing the maximum number of children that can be accommodated with the given l.
postconditions.description: The output should provide the maximum number of earthworm children that can be accommodated with each value of l, ensuring all conditions are met.

invariants.expression: The graph is a tree, meaning there is a unique path between any two rooms.
invariants.description: The graph representing the rooms and tunnels is a tree, ensuring connectivity and no cycles.

invariants.expression: Each leaf room is connected to the ground.
invariants.description: Each leaf room in the tree has a direct connection to the ground, representing the vertical tunnel.

invariants.expression: The difference in the time for the last and first child to reach the ground is not larger than l.
invariants.description: The maximum difference in the time for the last and first child to reach the ground is within the limit l.

invariants.expression: The occupied rooms form a connected set.
invariants.description: For any two occupied rooms, all rooms on the path between them are also occupied.
